tasks.gr8-industrial-revolution-in-britain-and: Topic: Industrial Revolution in Britain and Southern Africa. Cover industrialisation, urbanisation, child labour, trade unions, southern Africa by 1860, and diamond mining in Kimberley. Ask Grade 8 learners to analyse simple sources, sequence events, identify causes and consequences, and make evidence-based historical inferences.
tasks.gr8-britain-workers-and-protest-t1: Topic: Workers and protest in industrial Britain. Cover urbanisation, overcrowded housing, poverty and workhouses, child labour in mills and mines, the Luddites (industry), the Swing Riots (agriculture) and the Grand National Consolidated Trades Union of 1833, and how wealth and power grew in Britain. Ask Grade 8 learners to read source snippets from different points of view, say what each source does and does not tell us, and explain cause and effect. Keep contested numbers out of questions.
tasks.gr8-southern-africa-1860-indentured-labo: Topic: Southern Africa by 1860 and indentured labour. Cover the political settlement around 1860 (British colonies, Boer republics and independent African kingdoms), India as a British colony, why Natal sugar planters wanted labour (an independent Zulu kingdom, demand for sugar in Britain), the conditions of indentured labourers, and Passenger Indians from 1869. Ask Grade 8 learners to read short sources from planters and labourers, compare points of view, and use evidence. Keep contested numbers out of questions.
tasks.gr8-kimberley-diamonds-and-monopoly-t1: Topic: Diamond mining in Kimberley from 1867. Cover why diamonds are valuable, the British take-over of Griqualand West, one person one claim, what happened to black claimholders, digging deeper and the formation of companies, Cecil Rhodes and Barney Barnato, De Beers Consolidated Mines and the regulation of supply and price. Ask Grade 8 learners to read source snippets from diggers and company owners, compare points of view, and explain cause and effect. Keep contested numbers out of questions.
